title: Annulus term: integrability and dominated convergence of the kernel integrals (parent Steps 7 and 11)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Ambient n ℓ), μ a measure on E that is finite on compact sets, u, q: E → ℝ, ξ ∈ E and σ, ρ, R, A, C ∈ ℝ with σ > 0 and ρ ≤ R; u and q a.e. strongly measurable for μ restricted to B_R(ξ); |u(x)| ≤ A and |q(x)| ≤ 1 for x ∈ B_R(ξ). Let k_m: ℝ → ℝ (m ∈ ℕ) be Borel measurable with |k_m(s)| ≤ C for all s ≥ 0, k_m(s) = 0 for all s > R, and k_m(s) → 1_{(σ,ρ]}(s)·(sⁿ)^{-1} as m → ∞ for every s ≥ 0. Then x ↦ u(x)·(q(x)/|x − ξ|ⁿ) is μ-integrable on B_ρ(ξ) ∖ B_σ(ξ), and ∫ u(x)·q(x)·k_m(|x − ξ|) dμ(x) → ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)} u(x)·(q(x)/|x − ξ|ⁿ) dμ(x) as m → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (u q : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (σ ρ R A C : ℝ) (k : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → ρ ≤ R → AEStronglyMeasurable u (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → AEStronglyMeasurable q (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |u x| ≤ A ∧ |q x| ≤ 1) → (∀ m, Measurable (k m)) → (∀ m s, 0 ≤ s → |k m s| ≤ C) → (∀ m s, R < s → k m s = 0) → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Tendsto (fun m ↦ k m s) atTop (𝓝 ((Ioc σ ρ).indicator (fun s ↦ (s ^ n)⁻¹) s))) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n)) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ x, u x * q x * k m ‖x - ξ‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) ∂μ))
